lines.en: Did the young man speak English?
lines.cn: 那个年轻人会说英语吗？

lines.en: I had an amusing experience last year.
lines.cn: 去年我有一段非常有趣的经历。

lines.en: After I had left a small village in the south of France,
lines.cn: 在我离开法国南部的一个小村庄之后……

lines.en: I drove on to the next town.
lines.cn: 我继续开车前往下一个城镇。

lines.en: On the way, a young man waved to me.
lines.cn: 在路上，一个年轻人向我挥手致意。

lines.en: I stopped and he asked me for a lift.
lines.cn: 我停了下来，他请求我载他一程。

lines.en: As soon as he had got into the car,
I said good morning to him in French and he replied in the same language.
lines.cn: 我用法语向他道了早安，他也用同样的语言回应了我。

lines.en: I do not know any French at all.
Neither of us spoke during the journey.
lines.cn: 在旅途中，我们俩都没有说话。

lines.en: I had nearly reached the town, when the young man suddenly said, very slowly,
lines.cn: 我差不多已经走到镇上了，这时那个年轻人突然非常缓慢地说：

lines.en: As I soon learnt, he was English himself!
lines.cn: 很快我就发现，他本人就是英国人！
